about: Cash prizes offered by third parties (not by this site, which takes no cut), other than the Clay Millennium Prizes and Erdős prizes (handled in lib/catalog.ts). Each entry was checked against the prize holder's own page.

BealConjecture.beal_conjecture.by: Andrew Beal; the money is held in trust by the American Mathematical Society (Beal Prize)
BealConjecture.beal_conjecture.claim: Awarded by an AMS-appointed committee for a proof or a counterexample published in a refereed, respected mathematics publication
